item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Firefighters get a handle on Spokane wildfires as tens of thousands remain evacuated
item.description: Firefighters have taken advantage of cooler weather to begin getting a handle on wildfires that have displaced tens of thousands of people around Washington state's second-largest city.

[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump is on tour touting the economy, but Americans seem to be losing confidence in the message
item.description: President Trump was on the west coast Tuesday and Wednesday touting his economic message. But Americans seem to be losing confidence in his administration’s plan for the economy.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for August 5
item.description: PCTA: Agreement reached with district over health insurance costs for educators, Tampa Bay community unites on affordability crisis, dry Thursday ahead

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa begins $1 million repaving project on New Tampa Boulevard after years of resident complaints
item.description: Tampa is repaving 1.8 miles of New Tampa Boulevard in a $1 million project. Crews work overnight for 6–8 weeks to fix years of damage.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County commissioners vote to study AI data center impacts, direct attorney to draft moratorium
item.description: Hillsborough County commissioners voted unanimously on Wednesday to direct staff to study the impacts of artificial intelligence data centers.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Seminole Hard Rock Casino: Two robbery cases under investigation in Tampa
item.description: The Tampa Police Department and Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office are each investigating separate cases involving different victims who were allegedly robbed after leaving the Seminole Hard Rock Casino.
